card.name: Gestational age cutoffs for preterm birth
card.fires_on: Small words, spaces or the first digit just before a number of weeks of gestation, in text about preterm or premature births. It fires where a cutoff such as 'before 28 weeks' or 'less than 34 weeks' is about to appear.

modes.label: Cutoff words before weeks
modes.description: Words like before, under, less than or a space or '<' right before a gestational week number.
